reading.body:
Liberty Center One sits in Royal Oak, Michigan, with no published power capacity, square footage, or facility certifications on the operator's homepage. The facility has been mapped and its address verified, but the figures necessary to assess its scale or purpose remain unpublished.

Michigan has six mapped data center facilities across the state, yet none publish megawatt capacity on their operator spec pages. Liberty Center One ranks first by published capacity in Michigan only because all other facilities in the state also publish zero figures. This ranking reflects absence of disclosure rather than superiority.

Without published power specifications, the site's relevance to AI infrastructure cannot be determined from available data. An operator choosing not to disclose capacity typically signals either that the facility serves purposes other than large-scale compute, or that publication would not serve the operator's business interests. Readers assessing AI's grid constraint should note this facility as unmeasured rather than as part of Michigan's data center footprint.
